monrovia.summary: A mother bear was euthanized by California Department of Fish and Wildlife after attacking a woman walking her dog in Monrovia, leaving some community members expressing sympathy for the animal and its orphaned cubs. The city is moving forward with improvements, receiving a $460,000 grant for Recreation Park design and asking residents to weigh in on a proposed wastewater rate increase of $2.50 to $2.75 per month at a hearing scheduled for May 27. On the lighter side, Monrovia's athletes are shining with baseball player Troy Grise named Southern California Player of the Week and the swim team taking first place at the Savanna Invitational.

Meanwhile, LAUSD teachers and their unions are threatening to strike by mid-April if contract negotiations don't reach a deal, potentially disrupting schools across the district.
